analyst.summary: CESC is a well-established power distribution utility, mainly in Kolkata, trading at an inexpensive valuation with a healthy dividend. Its growth, however, is structurally slow -- capped by the pace of regulatory approvals and new licence wins -- at around 10% a year, and a meaningful part of reported profit comes from regulatory income rather than core operations. We rate this a Sell given the growth outlook does not justify holding purely for cheapness.
